extensions.contrast: Three separately anticorrelated, fair contexts give 3 and have no joint extension
extensions.requiredLaw: A single setting-independent joint distribution over three binary records
extensions.scope: Abstract contextual probability model; not a demonstrated quantum or friend implementation.
extensions.title: Three-record gluing test

extensions.contrast: If the bad sector is also no-signaling: G <= 6+4 epsilon, attained; epsilon >= (G-6)/4. See Shared.LF_NS_fraction_required and Shared.LF_NS_contamination_attained.
extensions.requiredLaw: Mixture of an LF behavior and an arbitrary normalized behavior; outside fraction epsilon
extensions.scope: Conservative arbitrary-behavior bound. Fraction of non-LF runs is not communication, signaling strength, or a causal influence metric.
extensions.title: LF contamination budget

extensions.contrast: Joint access and parity decoder succeeds with 1
extensions.requiredLaw: Two independent fair classical bits; decoder sees only one share
extensions.result: Every randomized one-share decoder succeeds with 1/2
extensions.scope: Operational access changes. Passive invertible relabeling leaves predictions unchanged; no quantum subsystem-recovery claim.
extensions.title: Access to a parity-encoded record

extensions.requiredLaw: Normalized real target; coherently superpose XZ and ZX; dephase order control with strength p
extensions.scope: Gate-specific calibration. A known-gate fixed-order circuit can imitate this statistic; not a causal-nonseparability or friend-order witness.
extensions.title: Pauli-order interference

extensions.contrast: Every pure real product amplitude has determinant zero
extensions.requiredLaw: Pure real two-qubit amplitudes; coherent CZ applied to |++>
extensions.result: Normalized output has determinant -1/2 and is not a product amplitude
extensions.scope: Pure-state calculation; requires purity and state reconstruction. No gravity model, coupling scale, mixed-state separability theorem, or generic classical-mediator exclusion.
extensions.title: Controlled-phase product-state test

extensions.requiredLaw: Two fair bits; at most one classical bit query; arbitrary randomized response and query choice
extensions.scope: A small exact algorithm-class obstruction, not an asymptotic complexity result or a bound on coherent quantum queries.
extensions.title: Classical query-budget recovery

extensions.contrast: Zero adjacent disagreement forces zero end-to-end disagreement
extensions.requiredLaw: A single joint distribution over three public binary records A,B,C
extensions.scope: Does not compose inaccessible observer-relative records; the common joint distribution is an explicit premise.
